scope: Actual linked HOST tools; help and argument preflight only, before BFD initialization and project device/file access. Not deployed/native or dump/Dwarf workload qualification.

source_review.mcinspect: mcinspect_main_entry_result resets flags then option parsing feeds mcinspect_main_body_result, whose help/missing-kernel/no-action returns precede init_bfd_symbols and open_readonly.
source_review.eclair: options(-h) leaves interactive=0 and sets help; main prints banner and returns2 after usage before setup_symbols or dump/GDB paths.

tests.label: mcinspect_help
tests.stdout:
Usage: mcinspect-real <options>
Inspect internal state of McKernel.

Mandatory arguments to long options are mandatory for short options too.
    --help                      Display this help message.
    --kernel PATH               Path to kernel image.
    --ps                        List processes running on LWK.
    --vtop                      Dump page tables.
    -v, --va ADDR               Dump page tables for ADDR only.
    -p, --pid PID               Use process PID for vtop.
    --debug                     Enable debug mode.

Examples: 
    mcinspect-real --kernel=smp-x86/kernel/mckernel.img --ps
    mcinspect-real --kernel=smp-x86/kernel/mckernel.img --vtop --pid 100 --va 0x3fffff800000
